description: Build a multi-file data pipeline where constants from one file determine transformations in three others.
instruction:
This project has a data pipeline across four source files. `src/constants.js` defines the transformation parameters (scale factor, offset, precision). The three pipeline stages — `src/normalize.js`, `src/transform.js`, and `src/format.js` — each need to import and apply these constants correctly.

Your job: read the constants in `src/constants.js`, then implement the three pipeline modules so that:
1. `normalize(values)` divides each value by `SCALE_FACTOR` from constants.
2. `transform(values)` adds `OFFSET` to each value from constants.
3. `format(values)` rounds each value to `PRECISION` decimal places from constants and returns strings.

The pipeline entry point `src/pipeline.js` chains them: normalize → transform → format. The test suite verifies the full pipeline output. `node --test` must pass.
